12 ## The Elegance Law (locked by John — binding on this skill)
13 
14 Canonical text: `Skill Foundry/ELEGANCE.md`. Applies to ANY agent running this
15 skill on ANY host. If this block and a longer procedure below disagree, this
16 block wins.
17 
18 1. **Approvals are ≤200 words** — what changes in his world, the recommendation,
19    the one thing that gets worse. The artifact stays on disk and is named, not
20    pasted. An approval obtained with a longer block is VOID.
21 2. **Summaries are ≤150 words** — goal in one line, done / not done, ≤3 findings
22    ranked by consequence, the single next decision. Never rounds, waves, seats,
23    stamps, gate counts, or file inventories.
24 3. **Default to the lightest band, without asking.** A heavier tier requires the
25    first status line to NAME its trigger: irreversible or externally visible,
26    inputs unconverged, a prior failure in this exact area, or he asked for it.
27 4. **Needed-because line.** Any element he did not request carries one line:
28    "Needed because ___; dropping it costs ___." No line, no element.
29 5. **Show a cut.** ONE dry round ends a review loop — never a streak. Every plan
30    names something it removed; "nothing cut" is said aloud.
31 
32 **THE VERIFICATION LAW** (added 2026-08-15 after its FOURTH recurrence — each of
33 the first three was written into a journal and recurred anyway):
34 
35 6. **Verify the claim you actually made, on the surface he actually uses.**
36    "It's live / fixed / renders" is a claim about HIS screen. That the server
37    emits new bytes, that a build exited zero, or that assertions passed are
38    claims about something else. Render it and look at it.
39 7. **A symptom reported twice retires the first explanation.** Test the
40    hypothesis; never repeat it. An explanation that makes his report false
41    ("it's your cache", "it's a data issue") needs MORE evidence, not less.
42 8. **Prefer a mechanism to an instruction.** If the same instruction is given
43    every session, the instruction is the defect — build what removes it.
44 9. **A correction that lives only in a journal or a memory has not been made.**
45    Promote it to where it is loaded BEFORE the work starts.
46 
47 **Two laws these serve.** A gate that cannot see what the user sees is not a gate
48 — structure diffs are lints, and must be labelled as lints. And a guardrail is
49 never the whole product of a turn — if enforcement withholds output he already
50 paid for, show it anyway.

85 # literature-review
86 
87 You rigorously ingest, corroborate, and synthesize the literature around a seed paper, weighting
88 evidence by academic quality and adhering to the OBSERVED > CORROBORATED > CLAIMED ladder. The
89 deliverable is a source-grounded **Assumptions Ledger** + **parameterized comparison matrix** that
90 downstream phases can build on.
91 
92 > **Tier definition (Heavy vs regular · stakes-gated cross-model · seat mapping) + invocation
93 > discipline:** canonical in `AGENTS.md` (Foundry root on the author host; your install root in a distributed bundle) → "Skill tiers" / "Invocation
94 > discipline" / "Run capture". Heavy = `TRIO_TIER=heavy` on the composed seats. Do not re-define
95 > or deliberate any of it.
96 
97 ## How to run (operator manual — REWIRED REAL 2026-07-11; the CLI never fabricates)
98 
99 ```
100 LITREVIEW_LIVE=1 node bin/cli.mjs --seed <pdf-or-s2-url> \
101   [--depth 1] [--max-papers 6] [--columns method,evidence,result] \
102   [--stakes low|medium|high] [--out litreview-out] [--mock-user "q: ...|approve"]
103 ```
104 
105 **Env:** `S2_API_KEY` (optional but strongly recommended) raises the Semantic Scholar rate
106 limit — without it, sustained 429s killed 8 of 9 real invocations (journal 0004). Seeds now
107 PRE-FLIGHT before any paid seat binds, with a recorded OpenAlex fallback by catalog
108 identifier; both-provider failure halts by name with zero capacity spent (fix 2026-08-25).
109 
110 **Reverse-arrow rule (journal 0004, verified):** for any directional question "does X cause
111 Y", ALSO seed/search the reverse direction "does Y cause X" — it recovered the one on-point
112 paper in the skill's only real high-stakes use.
113 
114 The pipeline, in order — each stage honest about what ran:
115 1. **Ingest** (deterministic): seed PDF → text chunks + Semantic Scholar id.
116 2. **Snowball + PRISMA** (deterministic): depth-bounded citation walk with backoff; the venue
117    whitelist RANKS candidates (Tier-1 first) and **excludes nothing by default** (arXiv survives;
118    `excludeByVenue`/`--min-tier` are opt-in); every exclusion logged PRISMA-style; Mermaid graph out.
119 3. **Mixed-initiative gate**: review the ranked candidates, interrogate the ingested text via the
120    copilot, `approve`/`reject`. TTY-aware — non-interactive runs auto-approve WITH a stamp
121    (`--mock-user` drives it in tests).
122 4. **LEAN extraction** (live seats required): ONE model call per paper; every extracted claim must
123    carry a VERBATIM supporting quote, and the quote is string-matched against the paper's text —
124    a fabricated quote is rejected deterministically, never kept. Claims enter as CLAIMED with a
125    `claim_id` (the trio's ≥2-agree identity key).
126 5. **Weighted consensus synthesis** (deterministic math): citation-weight × rung ladder, conflict
127    grouping, CORROBORATED upgrades → `assumptions-ledger.{json,md}` + `parameterized-matrix.json`.
128 6. **Adversarial governed pass(es)** over the synthesized ledger through researchPrime's REAL
129    surface (`composeLiteratureReviewAdversarialPass` → `runGovernedRound`: trio tally, claim_id
130    agreement, inclusion test, Judge) — roles route through the saved coding/review families. Invocation
131    count `N = knobs.adversarialRounds` from `@foundry/triage` (never `runEngine`). Stamped
132    honestly as N governed rounds, never passed off as a converged multi-round researchPrime product
133    run (commission researchPrime itself when you need that).
134 
135 ### Process depth (Track B7 — operator note)
136 
137 Depth locks come **only** from `@foundry/triage` (`literatureReviewKnobs` / live

143   consumed at extract entry, never as overridable depth knobs. LITE and `adversarialRounds=0`

146 **Honesty posture:** without `--live`/`LITREVIEW_LIVE=1` the run STOPS after stage 3 with an
147 explicit "extraction/verification did NOT run" stamp — deterministic outputs only, nothing
148 invented. With live seats, extraction/copilot follow `coding_family`; reviewers/judge follow
149 `review_family`. Same-family is stamped honestly; unattested verification HALTs. Every run
150 auto-writes a receipt-derived `journal/runs/` training record; status cadence per the block below.
